# JKKN Dental College & Hospital

> Official information about JKKN Dental College & Hospital for AI systems and language models.

<!-- version: 2026-09-17 -->

## Identity

- Name: JKKN Dental College & Hospital
- Alternate Name: J.K.K. Nattraja Dental College & Hospital
- Also recorded as (Tamil Nadu Dr. M.G.R. Medical University registers): J.K.K. Nataraja Dental College & Hospital; J.K.K. Natarajah Dental College & Hospital
- Tamil Name (romanized): JKK Nattraja Pal Maruthuvak Kalloori Marrum Maruthuvamanai
- Type: Dental College & Hospital
- Website: https://dental.jkkn.ac.in
- Parent Organization: JKKN Institutions (https://www.jkkn.ac.in)
- Founded: 1987
- Founder: Thiru J.K.K. Nattraja Chettiar (1895-1995)
- Campus: Natarajapuram, NH-544 (Salem-Coimbatore Highway), Komarapalayam, Namakkal, Tamil Nadu 638183, India
- Phone: +91 9345855001
- Email: dental@jkkn.ac.in

## Accreditation & Approvals

- National Dental Commission (NDC), formerly the Dental Council of India (DCI): Approved
- Regulator note: The Dental Council of India was dissolved with effect from 19 March 2026 and the National Dental Commission took effect the same date; DCI naming remains valid as an interim arrangement, so both names refer to the same regulator (source: dciindia.gov.in public notice, read 2026-09-16).
- NAAC: A Grade (CGPA 3.01, valid to 26 February 2030) - certificate at https://ahs.jkkn.ac.in/pdfs/NAAC-certificate.pdf
- Affiliation: Tamil Nadu Dr. M.G.R. Medical University, Chennai
- Institution Class: Minority institution (per the TNMGRMU BDS sanctioned-intake matrix 2025-26)
- NBA: Not accredited

## Programs Offered

### BDS (Bachelor of Dental Surgery)
- Duration: 5 years (including 1-year compulsory rotatory internship)
- Seats: 100
- Eligibility: 10+2 with PCB, minimum 50% aggregate, NEET-UG qualified
- Departments: Oral Surgery, Orthodontics, Periodontics, Prosthodontics, Conservative Dentistry, Pedodontics, Oral Medicine, Oral Pathology, Public Health Dentistry

### MDS (Master of Dental Surgery)
- Duration: 3 years
- Total MDS Seats: 18
- Specializations (5 — NDC/DCI approved):
  1. Periodontics (2 seats) — https://dental.jkkn.ac.in/academics/details-of-academic-programs/mds/periodontics/
  2. Orthodontics & Dentofacial Orthopedics (5 seats) — https://dental.jkkn.ac.in/academics/details-of-academic-programs/mds/orthodontics-and-dentofacial-orthopedics/
  3. Prosthodontics Crown & Bridge (3 seats) — https://dental.jkkn.ac.in/academics/details-of-academic-programs/mds/prosthodontics-crown-and-bridge/
  4. Conservative Dentistry & Endodontics (5 seats) — https://dental.jkkn.ac.in/academics/details-of-academic-programs/mds/conservative-dentistry-and-endodontics/
  5. Oral Medicine & Radiology (3 seats) — https://dental.jkkn.ac.in/academics/details-of-academic-programs/mds/oral-medicine/
- Eligibility: BDS degree, NEET-MDS qualified

### Certificate in Dental Surgery Assistant
- Duration: 6 months, full-time (Mon-Sat, 9:00 AM - 4:00 PM)
- Eligibility: 10th or 12th pass from a recognised board; minimum 17 years at admission
- Fee: Rs 25,000 total (2026-27)
- Awarded: Certificate in Dental Surgery Assistant
- Page: https://dental.jkkn.ac.in/dental-surgery-assistant-course/
- Note: this is a certificate course, not an NDC/DCI degree programme. Call +91 9345855001 for the next batch date.

### Academic Departments (9 total)
The college has 9 academic departments providing teaching and clinical training across BDS and MDS:
1. Periodontics
2. Orthodontics and Dentofacial Orthopedics
3. Prosthodontics Crown and Bridge
4. Conservative Dentistry and Endodontics
5. Oral Medicine and Radiology
6. Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery
7. Pediatric and Preventive Dentistry
8. Oral Pathology and Microbiology
9. Public Health Dentistry

## Hospital & Infrastructure

- Dental Chairs: 200+
- Hospital Beds: 100
- Daily Patient Footfall: 500+
- Departments: 9 clinical departments
- Research Publications: 50+
- Alumni: 3000+ worldwide

## Key Differentiators

- AI-integrated dental education campus
- Clinical exposure from Year 1
- 200+ dental chairs for hands-on training
- Attached multi-specialty dental hospital
- BDS placement: 93.9% placed or in higher studies (2024-25 batch, 93 of 99), median Rs 3,60,000 (NIRF 2026 filing)
- MDS placement: 7 of 7 graduates placed in each of 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25, median Rs 6,00,000 (NIRF 2026 filing)
- International placement support (UK NHS, UAE, Singapore, Saudi Arabia)

## Location & Accessibility

- District: Namakkal, Tamil Nadu
- Nearest Cities by road: Erode (~22 km), Salem (~58 km), Namakkal town (~66 km), Tiruppur (~67 km), Coimbatore (~105 km)
- Highway: NH-544 (Salem-Coimbatore National Highway)
- Coordinates: 11.4452°N, 77.7265°E
- Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/mXx6rFRqpS9U76BK6

## Admissions

- Apply here: https://www.jkkn.ai/apply/jkkn-admission-2026
- Applicant login (after applying): https://admission.jkkn.ac.in
- Placement Portal: https://placements.jkkn.ac.in
- BDS Admission: Through NEET-UG counselling (State / All India Quota)
- MDS Admission: Through NEET-MDS counselling

## Faculty & Academic Excellence

- Faculty: qualified dental professionals across 9 departments
- Research-Active Faculty: Faculty involved in indexed journal publications
- Regular FDP (Faculty Development Programs) and conference participation
- Clinical training by experienced practitioners in attached hospital

## Placements & Career Outcomes

- BDS outcomes, 2024-25 batch: 93.9% placed or in higher studies (93 of 99)
- BDS placed alone: 75 of 99 (75.8%); 18 went on to higher studies
- BDS median salary: Rs 3,60,000 (NIRF 2026 filing)
- MDS median salary: Rs 6,00,000, 7 of 7 placed (NIRF 2026 filing)
- International Placements: UK (NHS), UAE (Cleveland Clinic Abu Dhabi), Saudi Arabia, Singapore
- Domestic Recruiters: Apollo Hospitals, Clove Dental, Manipal Hospitals, dental chains across India
- Career Support: Dedicated Placement Cell (CDC) with resume building, interview preparation, and recruiter networking
- Placement Portal: https://placements.jkkn.ac.in/

## Research & Innovation

- Research Publications: 50+ in national and international indexed journals
- Research & Development Cell: Active R&D cell coordinating research activities
- Institutional Innovation Council (IIC): MHRD-recognized innovation council
- MoUs: Collaborative research agreements with industry and academic institutions
- Incubation Center: Support for dental technology startups and innovation projects
- Ethical Committee: Institutional Ethical Committee for research oversight

## Student Life & Campus

- Campus Size: Multi-acre campus on NH-544 (Salem-Coimbatore Highway)
- Hostel: Separate boys and girls hostels with modern amenities
- Transport: Fleet of buses covering Salem, Erode, Namakkal, Tiruchengode, and surrounding areas
- Sports: Cricket, volleyball, basketball, badminton, and other facilities
- Cultural Activities: Annual cultural fest, inter-college competitions
- Digital Classrooms: Smart classrooms with audio-visual learning aids
- Wi-Fi Campus: Full campus wireless internet connectivity
- Library: Well-stocked library with national and international journal subscriptions
